fact: The Disaster Management Authority and the Lesotho Meteorological Services held a five-day workshop in Leribe to develop and validate impact-based forecasting products and operational thresholds, and an LMS forecaster said LMS communicates warnings based on forecast thresholds through radio, television, social media, websites and district structures.
title: LESOTHO'S KEY STAKEHOLDERS AND CLIMATE TECHNICAL EXPERTS GATHERED TO DEVELOP AND VALIDATE DISASTER FORECASTING AND EARLY ACTION PLANS AHEAD OF EL NINO AND OTHER HAZARDS.
